content.title: Flow-Carried Style Escalation | Baseline, Identity Check, Split Convergence
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change. Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography. Escalate styling in ordered density levels from practical clothing to tailored and sculptural looks without changing every visual channel at once. Insert one bounded portrait checkpoint that re-verifies stable identity anchors before the terminal full-body phase. Split the carrier into two visibly distinct branches, then recombine them into one stable two-part hero design and hold the completed result.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change. + Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography. + Escalate styling in ordered density levels from practical clothing to tailored and sculptural looks without changing every visual channel at once. + Insert one bounded portrait checkpoint that re-verifies stable identity anchors before the terminal full-body phase. + Split the carrier into two visibly distinct branches, then recombine them into one stable two-part hero design and hold the completed result.
quick_start.recommended_input: On an ivory cyclorama, establish one clearly adult auburn-haired exhibition designer in a sand utility jumpsuit, front-facing with stable oval face, shoulder-length wave and tall proportions; one broad cobalt fabric ribbon enters from frame left and remains the only transformation carrier. The same ribbon gains one copper edge and expands behind her as a readable spatial layer; reveal an original sculptural cobalt evening look, then a copper-accented formal look, increasing silhouette volume without changing the adult identity or studio axis. Separate the carrier into cobalt and copper branches, show both traveling continuously around the same adult, then let them meet at center and resolve into one original asymmetrical cobalt-and-copper hero suit. Clear the ribbons, hold the complete full-body result for one second, no logos or text.

The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Escalate styling in ordered density levels from practical clothing to tailored and sculptural looks without changing every visual channel at once.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Insert one bounded portrait checkpoint that re-verifies stable identity anchors before the terminal full-body phase.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Split the carrier into two visibly distinct branches, then recombine them into one stable two-part hero design and hold the completed result.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult woman's face, body, hair changes, poses and all casual or couture garments
the source black and gray ink-smoke appearance, plume shapes, pools, wing silhouettes and exact morph transitions
the source white studio, rocks, transparent blocks, lighting pattern and black-white-silver palette
the source T-shirt lettering, CapCut AI watermark and any other visible marks or wording
the source exact shot order, face crops, shoulder turn, dress designs, timing, creator identity and quoted prompt context
